title: FACT rule, attribution (O25) and F(m, c), decided on the extracted real code

predictions.claim: Basis (rules F1-F7 over spec/M2/facts/morph_rollup.extracted.json; holon fact writes gen/M3/fact/morph_rollup.extracted.json): exactly one commitment, committedBatches, with 4 commitment sites (writes[0] of commitBatch, commitBatchWithProof, commitState and importGenesisBatch, each keccak256 of a header region) and 7 authenticating guard reaches committedBatches[k] == keccak256(header) (commitBatch guards[16], commitBatchWithProof guards[16], commitState guards[15], finalizeBatch guards[6], proveCommittedBatchState guards[4], proveState guards[7], revertBatch guards[6]); the delivered-data consumer blobhash for commitBatch, commitBatchWithProof and commitState (importGenesisBatch reads no blob hash): 3 kernel basis elements; exactly one attribution consumer, batchDataStore.submitter, the argument of proveState calls[1] ISubmitter.slash (Rollup.sol:806) after guards[7] (Rollup.sol:603) authenticates the batch; exactly two pins of batchBlobVersionedHashes at the commitment key (commitState writes[2] Rollup.sol:359, the copy; commitBatchWithProof writes[2], the branch under a nonzero stored word), its writers commitBatch fresh, commitBatchWithProof branch, commitState copy, finalizeBatch clear, importGenesisBatch fresh; two attribution basis elements, recording the caller (commitState) and the literal 0 (commitBatchWithProof). 5 FACT basis elements, exactly as spec/M3/lib/fact_basis.json lists them.

Laws (F4, F7, F8; catalog holon-rules/1.5): holon derive --milestone M3 emits exactly 5 FACT laws, all over the extracted rollup document and none over a hand document: L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatch_committedBatches_blobhash, L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_committedBatches_blobhash, L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitState_committedBatches_blobhash (binders s1: Reach, x1: Act, s2: Reach, x2: Act, then I30's hash binders) and L_fact_attr_Rollup_commitState_batchBlobVersionedHashes_batchDataStore_submitter, L_fact_attr_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_batchBlobVersionedHashes_batchDataStore_submitter (binders p: Trace, y: Act, then the hash binders); claim fact_ok[<fact id>](binders) == true; premises blobs_wf, cf:<h> and nz:<h> per hash binder, and hyp:Hyp-Z0-kzg exactly on the commitBatch and commitBatchWithProof kernel laws (their records hold the literal ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH); DERIVATION entries and refs fact:<id> as the contract states.

Measure (F9, Def 6.13): F(Z, derivation) = 1 bit. The measure of L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatch_committedBatches_blobhash is 1 bit: max fiber 2, the committed blob word ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH coming from the delivered lists [] and [ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH] at versions 0 and 1 (Rollup.sol:915 allows at most one blob below version 2), every other fiber holding one list (version 2: keccak256 of the list, injective under CF); L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_committedBatches_blobhash: 1 bit (its fresh branch, stored word 0; its header-hash check guards[19].reaches[0] unevaluated); L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitState_committedBatches_blobhash: 0 bits (Rollup.sol:276 admits only []); the attribution laws have no measure. Exactly fact_basis.json's computation.

L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_committedBatches_blobhash is REFUTED: two commitBatchWithProof calls of its fresh branch with identical calldata at version 0 or 1 and the blob-hash lists [] and [ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH], both succeeding (after the rollup delay, with a proof the binding's verifier stand-in accepts) with equal committedBatches[k]; L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitState_committedBatches_blobhash is PROVED by the guard route of holon.gen.mproofs.product (Rollup.sol:276 'commitState must not carry blob' fixes both delivered lists to []), with a checked reachable inhabitant (G11V), its record naming the route "guard", and law_terms within the term budget 1000 (spec/M3/lib/term_size.json measure (1), recomputed from its law and proof files, whose imports the measure counts).

O25/N3: L_fact_attr_Rollup_commitState_batchBlobVersionedHashes_batchDataStore_submitter (whose bond is at risk on a recommit, against who chose the content under the BVH pin) is REFUTED by the chain: prefix exactly [commitBatch of batch k by S1, revertBatch by the owner covering k] (S1 one of the binding's two active submitters, 0x...1002 or 0x...1003), y = commitState of k by the other active submitter S2 with no blob (the pinned content; chooser S1), bonded batchDataStore[k].submitter = S2; consumer continuation t = [challengeState of k by the binding's challenger 0x...1004, proveState of k at or after the challenge's startTime + proofWindow], whose real ISubmitter.slash call passes S2, not S1. The witness replays on the real Rollup (replay/M3/fact/report.json passed). The record lists Hyp-ISubmitter with roles interpretation and witness (result fail, F-M2-40), unconditional false, impact_conditional_on [Hyp-ISubmitter].

L_fact_attr_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_batchBlobVersionedHashes_batchDataStore_submitter is REFUTED (O20's implicit address(0) role, under the pin): prefix exactly [commitBatch of k by S1, revertBatch by the owner], y = commitBatchWithProof of k taking the stored branch (no blob), bonded 0 (address(0) recorded), chooser S1; t = [] (no consumer continuation within continuation_depth 2: the proof-backed batch's finalizeTimestamp is the step's time, so challengeState of k reverts outside the window); the replay passes with the real batchDataStore[k].submitter 0. The record lists Hyp-ISubmitter (interpretation, witness; fail) and HypV-proof1 (witness; untestable); unconditional false.

Exit (witnesses replay): every REFUTED FACT witness (4: two kernel, two attribution) replays on the real Rollup at the pinned commit: replay/M3/fact/report.json passed, model == real at every step, calls_agree; the independent raw-call replay through the harness copies taken at this prereg gives the report's real observations; kernel: both x succeed and the real committedBatches[k] after them are equal; attribution: the real batchDataStore[k].submitter after y equals the bonded value and differs from the chooser.

Thm 6.8 (F = 0 iff the factorization holds): results/M3/fact/classification.json lists the 5 FACT laws; the kernel laws' bits [1, 1, 0] (L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatch_committedBatches_blobhash, L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_committedBatches_blobhash, L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitState_committedBatches_blobhash) agree with their statuses [REFUTED, REFUTED, PROVED]; disagreements []. Totals over the 5 FACT laws: 1 PROVED, 4 REFUTED, 0 UNKNOWN.

Hypotheses (rule H1; a law resting on a failed or untestable premise or witness hypothesis is never presented as unconditional): every FACT record's hypotheses are H1 applied to its premises, status and witness. L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatch_committedBatches_blobhash lists Hyp-ISubmitter (witness: its commits ask the stand-in isActive; fail, F-M2-40), Hyp-Z0-kzg (premise; pass) and HypZ (interpretation; fail, F-M2-41): unconditional false, impact_conditional_on [HypZ]; L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatchWithProof_committedBatches_blobhash lists HypV-proof1 (witness: the verifier stand-in accepts its proof; untestable), Hyp-Z0-kzg (premise; pass) and HypZ (interpretation; fail): unconditional false, impact_conditional_on [HypZ]; L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitState_committedBatches_blobhash lists HypZ only (interpretation): unconditional true, impact_conditional_on [HypZ].

regressions.claim: Gates M0, M1 and M2 pass; M0-M2 laws, records and statement hashes are unchanged. results/M1/L_fact_Z.json stays REFUTED with statement hash sha256:5b3e051df5bfc68545307bd43c5c2ac7ec9bf9be54c6c9851f7757b25b5a512e and its witness (commitBatch version 1, no blob vs the zero-blob token 1, after the empty trace); I20's differential row L_fact_Z stays REFUTED on M1 and on the window view with no delta. No commit that writes an I26 outcome path touches spec/M1/, spec/M2/facts/, spec/M2/lib/ or an M0-M2 output.

The plan's regression: the parametric L_fact_Z analogue L_fact_kernel_Rollup_commitBatch_committedBatches_blobhash (premises blobs_wf, cf:<h>, hyp:Hyp-Z0-kzg, nz:<h>) is REFUTED, as L_fact_Z is: one shared empty prefix, x1 and x2 commitBatch calls with identical calldata at version 0 or 1 by one active submitter at one block.timestamp, blob-hash lists [] and [ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH], equal committedBatches[k]; and its implication to L_fact_Z checks (results/M3/fact/backtest.json, rules FB1-FB4): the moved witness (blob tokens [] and [1]) refutes L_fact_Z on gen/M1/model/morph_rollup.bend by a Bend-checked counter-law (witness transfer), and CF(agg, S) over S = {[], [1]} is checked by computation (agg 1000 and 1002 differ); acceptance witness, implication accepted, no gap, complete.

The M3 laws that exist before I26's first outcome commit (I24's PAR, I30's SORT, I27's UNDO and I31's DISCH; I25 derives none) keep their statuses, and their law files change only in rule_catalog_version (holon-rules/1.5).

Construction checks, not counted: spec/M3/lib/fact_basis.json is fact_basis_doc's computation over unchanged inputs; spec/M3/lib/fact.json transcribes I21's verdicts, the document's constant, the binding's encodings and the M1 agg; the harness copies are the binding's; the hand-built O25 chain and Z pair behave on the real Rollup as the instrument expects (run at this prereg); holon fact's document is deterministic and reads no hand document; holon-rules/1.5 holds FACT's producers and every earlier M3 catalog's (the same objects); holon/rules/fact.py and holon/measures_fact.py name no target and no file under holon/ names an I26 law or fact id; derive reproduces laws/M3 byte for byte; every FACT record is valid under v1 and v2; Bend accepts every FACT proof, nonvac proof and counter-law, with no escape hatch, and no real definition names a chooser companion; S1-S3 (renaming, no pin, zero sentinel) give the instrument's analysis; holon gate --milestone M3 --checks G1,G6,G11V passes on a copy.
